policies.title: Same-Day Dispatch & Cutoff
policies.summary: Orders confirmed before 2:00 PM WAT qualify for same-day Lagos dispatch. Orders after 2:00 PM WAT ship next business day. Interstate deliveries take 2 to 4 business days.

policies.title: Bank Transfer Reconciliation
policies.summary: Pending bank transfers older than 30 minutes require verification using the NIBSS session reference before releasing goods. Disputed transfers take up to 24 business hours.

policies.title: Low Stock & Reorder Thresholds
policies.summary: Flag SKUs for restock when stock drops to or below the reorder point, and never promise instant dispatch without checking incoming stock.
